evidence.notes: Named client certificates resolve from local certificate metadata and become inspectable HttpRequest mock metadata.
Inline certificate material and password presence are stored as deterministic request metadata visible to HttpCalloutMock.

source.content: @isTest private class CoreRuntimeHttpClientCertLocalTest { private class Mock implements HttpCalloutMock { public HttpResponse respond(HttpRequest req) { System.assertEquals('named', req.clientCertificateSource); System.assertEquals('LocalCert', req.clientCertificateName); HttpResponse res = new HttpResponse(); res.setStatusCode(204); return res; } } @isTest static void rows() { Test.setMock(HttpCalloutMock.class, new Mock()); HttpRequest req = new HttpRequest(); req.setEndpoint('https://example.test/cert'); req.setMethod('GET'); req.setClientCertificateName('LocalCert'); System.assertEquals(204, new Http().send(req).getStatusCode()); HttpRequest inlineReq = new HttpRequest(); inlineReq.setClientCertificate('-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE----- local', 'secret'); } }
